scope_summary: Implement JOURNAL_ACCOUNTING_V1 with Decimal FIFO opening-fee allocation, realized-gross and trade-fee postings, exact replay, and all JRN-005 golden vectors.
Add explicit posting kinds, source-fact uniqueness, deterministic posting IDs, stable position-event sequence numbers, and PostgreSQL/SQLite/ORM append-only guards.
Make ledger replay the only journal-balance authority and remove cash_balance/current_balance fallback or NAV labeling from journal surfaces.
Quarantine unresolved, duplicate, owner-invalid, currency-invalid, and account-currency-invalid legacy postings without guessing repairs.
Add accounting health, reconciliation cases, audited compensation, financial-mutation blocking, trusted aggregate exclusion, warnings, and repair tooling.
Prove empty and populated PostgreSQL upgrades, downgrade/re-upgrade, append-only triggers, concurrent identical posting races, API rollback, and degraded UI contracts.

verification.result: PASS on exact commit 4b350d97d2e06d8744fa41290fa18b9a31f43069: 491 backend tests including PostgreSQL, current OpenAPI and release contracts, 160 frontend tests, typecheck, lint, and 15-page production build.

fixed_findings.finding: The first migration draft quarantined only LEGACY_UNRESOLVED rows, so duplicate legacy posting keys could abort unique-key creation and owner/currency/account-amount divergence could remain trusted.
fixed_findings.resolution: The migration now assigns every unsafe row a unique LEGACY_UNRESOLVED source fact, creates reconciliation cases, degrades the account, and proves downgrade/re-upgrade on PostgreSQL.

fixed_findings.finding: The lifecycle router contained a duplicate exception branch for accounting conflicts.
fixed_findings.resolution: The duplicate branch was removed before the checkpoint.

residual_risks: JRN-007/JRN-008 still own account/position row locking, durable financial-command idempotency, and truth-native transactional OPEN/lifecycle writers.
JRN-009/JRN-010 still own product-complete immutable cash, dividend, trade reversal, and whole-position void commands.

Legacy accounts quarantined for structural owner or account-currency divergence may require an audited runbook rather than automatic compensation; the implementation deliberately keeps them degraded instead of guessing.
The product remains NOT_READY_FOR_PRODUCTION until the remaining active-plan exit gates are closed.

next_task_gate: SATISFIED: JRN-006 is closed; JRN-007 may start from migration head c3d4e5f6a7b8 and the implemented JOURNAL_ACCOUNTING_V1 oracle.
